caption:
Your voicemail greeting is turning away paying customers.

Most callers who hit voicemail hang up without leaving a message. The ones who do leave a message book a competitor before you call back.

Rewrite the greeting with three lines:

1. Name the business in the first line
2. Give a realistic callback window, like "within two hours"
3. Add one line: "You can also text this number right now"

Re-record it tonight. Tomorrow, have a friend call your main line and listen for all three.

rationale: Quick-tutorial to-camera reels win completion right now, and the voicemail greeting itself (not the automation layer) is a genuinely unclaimed, zero-cost, do-it-tonight fix distinct from every missed-call-text-back and speed-to-lead post already shipped.
